name: Hayes AT commands
summary: Command language for modems and cellular modules: lines start with AT, followed by basic commands (D dial, H hang-up, Z reset) and S-register settings or extended +-prefixed commands with set, read (?) and test (=?) forms; standardised in ITU-T V.250 and extended for mobile in 3GPP TS 27.007.

level_notes.0: Implementations are modem firmware; no reference implementation.
level_notes.2: Tutorials are vendor application notes for GSM/LTE modules.
